experiment: UJI B1 matched observation-field backend and direct-coordinate comparison

source_selection.rule: Minimum source B2 pooled position MDE among epochs0/1/2/3, earliest exact tie.

method_identities.A_field: Original source-trained HGB observation field, one model per training seed
method_identities.A_complete: Original source-trained HGB observation field with the fixed GP probability pool
method_identities.B_complete: Full-parameter native TabICLv2 observation field with the fixed GP probability pool
method_identities.C_direct: Native TabICLv2 episodic direct-coordinate source fine-tuning
method_identities.D_field: Public-weight native TabICLv2 observation field with legal source contexts
method_identities.D_complete: Public-weight native TabICLv2 observation field with the fixed GP probability pool
method_identities.GP_reference: Original multi-source GP adaptation, shared internal reference
method_identities.adopted_5seed_field: Existing five-HGB-model observation field, internal adopted reference
method_identities.adopted_5seed_complete: Existing five-HGB-model complete ReFi, internal adopted reference

metric: Pool original per-position mean scan errors. Repeated K budgets, split repeats and training seeds retain their identities and are not independent locations. P90 is a pooled quantile, never an average of task P90.

comparison_scope.A_B: Matched original 55/56 features, scan-count objectives, source rows per seed, candidate construction and fixed reader/GP. Different estimator families and pretraining.
comparison_scope.B_C: Complete field-learning pipeline versus ordinary episodic direct-coordinate fine-tuning with the same public regressor family, legal source buildings and H/S. Representation, supervision and inference all differ. C has one shared backbone, B has three task-specific native backbones.
comparison_scope.B_D: Train all native field weights versus frozen public weights. Same source context unit/alias selections per seed; each version uses its own legal opposite-half Tab means for scale labels.
comparison_scope.reference: Original five-HGB-seed complete and field predictions and native GP remain separate internal references.
comparison_scope.exposed_development: B1 has prior project results. This is frozen target evaluation after B0-to-B2 source selection, not a never-exposed external benchmark.

implementation.source_rows: All 648000 rows of the original HGB sampled source table per seed, with exact original-array parity
implementation.field_pretraining: Official native TabICLv2 classifier for detection and regressor for mean/scale. Different task-pretraining heads of the same family.
implementation.direct_pretraining: Same official v2 regressor checkpoint as the field regression roles
implementation.scale_supervision: Each field version uses its own legal two-half floor cross-fitted Tab mean for OOF log-variance targets
implementation.reader: Unchanged original candidate atoms, PreparedFrozenHurdle and fixed probability-half GP pool

public_checkpoint_provenance.pretraining_condition: Same TabICLv2 family with task-specific pretrained classifier/regressor heads; public pretraining corpus not audited.

timing_scope.meaning: Upper bound from actual GPU-stage process wall times including CPU preparation, checkpoint I/O and failed attempts. The outer driver idle interval is excluded. This is separate from pure optimizer time or online adaptation latency.

event_timing_scope.event_seconds: Recorded new field preparation/readout or direct deployment only. Shared GP surfaces are read from the checksum-bound cache and their original adaptation is not repeated. Reference events retain original task seconds.
event_timing_scope.source_training: See each source stage training.json/complete.json and formal driver stage exit records. Stage wall time includes source selection, OOF labels and serialization.
event_timing_scope.shared_GP: gp_surfaces metadata records score-surface recomputation with original saved adaptation state and full-H fields. It is not an online adaptation timing.

provenance.source_weights_and_NPZ_contexts: Retained at the checksum-bound server asset paths in source_model_assets
